## Preserved numerical boundary

`SCI-RTC-EQ-005` remains the existing conditioned-$x$ numerical operator.
`SCI-RTC-EQ-006` retains its zero fixed-state $x\leftarrow r$ branch. The new
paired identity in `SCI-RTC-EQ-036` adds only the requested conditioned-$r$
companion and the corresponding coordinate-diagonal/joint-covariance
semantics; it does not alter conditioned $x$.

## Deferred authority

Exact numerical choices for already-open RTC operations retain their existing
owner-ledger states. PTC use of conditioned $r$ and SCI-VAL aggregation remain
outside RTC authority. A consumer may act on RTC facts only under its own
contract and policy.
